reviewNotes: HOLD. Current Movistar Peru contract and prepaid pages establish an active prepaid product, S/5 recharge entry level, a provider-stated seven-month no-recharge cancellation threshold, app/in-person activation controls and current OSIPTEL in-person biometric requirements for foreign nationals. Current prepaid-specific overseas roaming/incoming-SMS coverage, mainland-China behavior and OTP reliability remain unestablished; postpaid roaming material is not transferred to this route.

events.outcome: Current prepaid contract ties recharge to active service and permits cancellation after seven months without recharge; current foreign-national acquisition is in-person/biometric, while prepaid-specific overseas SMS and China behavior remain unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Movistar Peru continues to sell prepaid service. Physical prepaid activation uses the Activa tu Chip Movistar app with SIM-barcode scan, customer data and fingerprint-photo identity validation; Movistar eSIM is currently obtained through authorized service centers. Foreign-national mobile contracting is subject to OSIPTEL current in-person biometric/identity-validation rules.

keep.action: Movistar's current prepaid contract says recharge keeps the mobile line active and the service may be cancelled after seven months without a recharge; unused recharge balance can be recovered for 210 days. Current prepaid benefits begin at S/5. A conservative two-S/5-recharges-per-year schedule stays inside the documented seven-month no-recharge threshold; the provider wording is 'may be cancelled', so this is not an exact day-210 cancellation guarantee.

data.chinaActivation: Acquisition is Peru-oriented. Current OSIPTEL rules require foreign-national contracting in person with biometric/identity validation; China-first acquisition/activation is not established.
data.kyc: Current prepaid activation uses identity validation. Under current OSIPTEL security measures, foreign nationals must contract in person with biometric verification against Migraciones or applicable Foreign Ministry identity validation.
data.payment: Movistar supports prepaid recharges from S/5 through its prepaid channels. Card/digital recharge exists, but reliable execution with a foreign-issued bank card was not explicitly established in the reviewed material.
data.roamingSms: Current Movistar pages found for international roaming are postpaid/plan-focused. A current prepaid-specific roaming entitlement, incoming-SMS rule, mainland-China coverage and third-party OTP reliability were not established and are not inferred from postpaid material.
data.holdReason: Prepaid-specific overseas roaming/incoming-SMS coverage, mainland-China behavior, OTP reliability and reliable foreign-card recharge execution remain unresolved; foreign-national acquisition is in-person/biometric.
data.tariffSummary: Current prepaid line; S/5 recharge floor; service may be cancelled after 7 months without recharge; foreign-national signup is in-person/biometric. Prepaid overseas SMS/China route remains unresolved.
guideSteps: Acquire and activate through current Peru channels and complete the applicable identity/biometric checks.
Recharge before the seven-month no-recharge threshold; do not treat the provider wording as an exact guaranteed cancellation date.
Do not transfer Movistar postpaid roaming claims to this prepaid route or claim China OTP without prepaid-specific evidence.
